claim_label: Youth Employment Decline in AI-Exposed Roles
description: After the release of GPT-4, employment of 22–25-year-olds in highly AI-exposed software development jobs fell by approximately 13%.

instances.assertion: After the release of GPT-4, employment of 22–25-year-olds in highly AI-exposed software development jobs fell by approximately 13%.
After GPT-4’s release, employment of 22–25-year-olds in highly AI-exposed software development jobs fell by approximately 13%.
Hiring for workers ages 22 to 25 in AI-exposed roles has dropped by approximately 14% since the launch of ChatGPT.
Employment of 22–25-year-olds in highly AI-exposed jobs fell by roughly 13% after GPT-4's release.
